what do you think?
"finish your plate or you can't leave your table" - this is why western countries are fat

I doubt that had any significant impact. I think there are several main reasons for the obesity epidemic.

  1. A constant abundance of food. For a lot of humans it's instinctual to eat way more than they need, because while there's no reason to be fat now, having extra body fat was a good thing when you had no idea when your next meal would be and a deadly famine could happen at any time, and there was rarely ever enough food to become too fat to begin with.

  2. Ridiculously calorie-dense food, making it way easier to consume tons and tons of calories at a time.

  3. Culture. Notice all the anti-fat (Japan, etc.) countries have little issue with obesity.

  4. The obsession with keeping people alive. I'm talking about anti-suicide measures, welfare, mental health, etc. Most people used to not have the time or resources to help strangers who weren't willing or able to take care of themselves, letting them die off or kill themselves. Now you have all these people with severe mental and physical disabilities who aren't fit to survive and contribute nothing, being kept alive by people obsessed with preserving life. People have become so prosperous they want to combat natural selection itself, basically. It's just so easy to stay alive now that just about anyone can do it, even people who are so fat their limbs rot off.

It's a huge Irish thing to be taught this, happens a lot in UK too. Comes down from the babyboomer generation post war still rationing food and not having enough to eat. You'd force your kids to finish regardless of how shitty the food tasted.

The issue is the portions. Nowadays the portions of food is just obscene. I'm all for finishing my plate but not if you've served me half a chicken, 6 potatoes, 2 cups of vegetables and slices of bread and butter. Plus the food got worse, we've had ready meals since the 70s but they weren't eaten everyday.

For me, I try to plate meals that I know my kid can eat. Sometimes they're a bit excessive, and if he says he's full, I trust that he is. If I've plated what I consider to be an appropriate meal and he doesn't finish it and says he's full, especially if it's something new that he hasn't tried before, I'll tell him that if he wants a snack later, he's finishing his supper.

Frankly, there's no excuse for "finish your plate or you can't leave the table." We all have refrigerators and microwaves. There is such a thing as leftovers. I don't get it at all. That's the most ironic thing: Forcing someone to clean their plate is forcing them to waste food, which is exactly what these people are trying to avoid but going about it in an entirely wrong and illogical way. This is ESPECIALLY true, in my mind, in terms of food insecurity. If you don't know where your next meal is coming from and you're full, why not save the rest for later? I absolutely do not understand.
